item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid maritime airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow, the weather will be foggy in the morning and at night over the region. It will be rather warm during the day. A cold front will move across Guangdong on Tuesday. Meanwhile, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon and its replenishment, temperatures will fall progressively and there will be a few rain patches over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will be rather cool towards the weekend. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly early next week.

Date/Month: 03/03 (Monday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Humid and foggy in the morning and at night. Rather warm with sunny intervals during the day. A few showers at night.
Temp range: 21 - 26 C
R.H. range: 70 - 100 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
